# MCP tool actions

Actions published as tools on CloudBolt's MCP server for AI agents to call. Each tool's inputs are its parameters; the code lives on the referenced plugin.

| Tool | ID | Description | MCP tool name | Enabled | Plugin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cancel Jobs | [MTA-js655cf3](MTA-js655cf3/README.md) | Sets the named jobs and their unfinished descendants to TO_CANCEL, like the jobs cancel endpoint. | `cancel_jobs` | yes | [Cancel Jobs](../plugins/OHK-2lzwvo0j/) |
| Compare Azure List Prices | [MTA-ab0krash](MTA-ab0krash/README.md) | Looks up Azure public list prices for any service across the regions of the Azure environments the caller can order into, with monthly estimates and hints for refining the search. | `compare_azure_list_prices` | yes | [Compare Azure List Prices](../plugins/OHK-r9cm4oar/) |
| Fetch Job Log | [MTA-8j9c0tb0](MTA-8j9c0tb0/README.md) | Returns a job's status, output, errors, progress log, child jobs, failed descendants, and sync results in one call so a failed job can be diagnosed. | `fetch_job_log` | yes | [Fetch Job Log](../plugins/OHK-2p0rhzup/) |
| Manage Blueprint Permissions | [MTA-ntmcnvv7](MTA-ntmcnvv7/README.md) | Lists, grants, or revokes a group's DEPLOY or MANAGE permission on a blueprint, so a repository sync's loss of group permissions can be snapshotted and restored. | `manage_blueprint_permissions` | yes | [Manage Blueprint Permissions](../plugins/OHK-mgta9oez/) |
| Order Counts by Blueprint | [MTA-lp8lgi7e](MTA-lp8lgi7e/) | Return the number of orders placed for each blueprint, optionally filtered by order status. | `order_counts_by_blueprint` | yes | [Order Counts by Blueprint](../plugins/OHK-yjblxbwg/) |
| POC Onboarding: Configure Custom Server | [MTA-i1kmy5fd](MTA-i1kmy5fd/README.md) | Makes the shipped Custom Server blueprint orderable for the POC: recreates it when missing, activates it, enables every environment on its server tier, and sets a hostname template on the tier or on the listed environments. | `onb_configure_custom_server` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Configure Custom Server](../plugins/OHK-ilstyopk/) |
| POC Onboarding: Failure Trace | [MTA-jzscq0mk](MTA-jzscq0mk/README.md) | Walks an order or job down to the jobs that actually failed and returns their errors, output, progress tail, failed children and a hint for the common provisioning failures, naming the job id to pass to fetch_job_log for the traceback. | `onb_failure_trace` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Failure Trace](../plugins/OHK-y95w8ai0/) |
| POC Onboarding: Handler Locations | [MTA-89dxppus](MTA-89dxppus/README.md) | Lists the regions, locations or clusters a resource handler can turn into environments, flags the ones already imported, lists the existing environments, and for an AWS region lists its VPCs. | `onb_handler_locations` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Handler Locations](../plugins/OHK-0nuhjdxl/) |
| POC Onboarding: Import Environments | [MTA-i6p4j2l7](MTA-i6p4j2l7/README.md) | Creates one environment per listed location on a resource handler the way the Import locations dialog does, brings the networks over (AWS subnets with the environment, Azure subnets synced, vCenter cluster networks attached to NIC 1), and reports existing environments instead of duplicating them. | `onb_import_environments` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Import Environments](../plugins/OHK-8j06wtoe/) |
| POC Onboarding: Import OS Build | [MTA-0dr8xi4i](MTA-0dr8xi4i/README.md) | Imports one image (AWS AMI, Azure marketplace image, vCenter template) into an OS build, reusing an existing build of the same name so one build spans handlers, and attaches the build to the handler's environments. | `onb_import_os_build` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Import OS Build](../plugins/OHK-k2p8ll4p/) |
| POC Onboarding: Install | [MTA-6zxrhdls](MTA-6zxrhdls/README.md) | Finishes the toolkit install after a sync or package import: sets Synchronous Action on the inline tools, enables every tool, checks outbound access to the Content Library and GitHub, and records the toolkit version. | `onb_install` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Install](../plugins/OHK-j60flmb3/) |
| POC Onboarding: Playbook | [MTA-92b836jb](MTA-92b836jb/README.md) | Returns a section of the POC onboarding skill text from the public cloudbolt-as-code repository, so MCP clients without skill support follow the same procedure. | `onb_playbook` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Playbook](../plugins/OHK-1am7i73s/) |
| POC Onboarding: Recent Errors | [MTA-hwg74btd](MTA-hwg74btd/README.md) | Reads the tail of a CloudBolt log and returns the recent WARNING-and-above entries grouped by exception and message, secrets redacted, each group with a hint for the failures a new appliance hits most. | `onb_recent_errors` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Recent Errors](../plugins/OHK-4vwq70dg/) |
| POC Onboarding: Remove Environment | [MTA-pz5o2gjl](MTA-pz5o2gjl/README.md) | Deletes an environment imported by mistake so the POC can start over; refuses while active servers live in it. | `onb_remove_environment` | yes | [POC Onboarding: Remove Environment](../plugins/OHK-1wmzl7sp/) |
